_note: The twenty-one Manchester United poster tiles shown on /posters/ (moved off the front page on 2026-10-13). One tile per Etsy listing; image is the listing photo at 900x675 under public/shop/ and alt is that photo's Etsy alt text. Keep in step with src/data/posters.ts (inclusion rules in its header). `home` (1 to 4) picks the four front-page tiles and their order: the homepage renders them from here (renderCovers in src/render/home.ts) and build-feed.mjs publishes the same four as /feed/home-covers.json for the app, so rotating the front-page posters is one edit here plus a deploy. A home tile must be a 900x675 webp; the build fails otherwise. `art` (gap4-5, 2026-11-15) records what the printed artwork itself carries, read off the file under public/posters/: every club name, every player name on a shirt or the goal timeline, and the quoted headline line (null when the poster has none). It is a record for the founder's ruling on the match posters, which is still open (CLAUDE.md, The quote posters and the app storefront), not a clearance: `ruling` stays "pending" until he decides. Nothing renders it.
